verdict: Maybe. Sparshbrush from Mumbai pitched automatic grooming brushes for cattle on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Comfortable cattle produce more milk, and automatic brushes are common on European dairy farms, but small Indian farms need a lower price.
angle: Dairy farms are getting larger and more professional, and owners are investing in animal comfort. Brushes, mats and cooling systems can raise milk yield. Larger dairy farms and gaushalas are the first buyers.
